remarks: THE OWNERS ARE REQUESTING THAT OFFERS BE SUBMITTED BY NOON MONDAY. Rarely available on coveted Kimberly Place, this beautifully redesigned & renovated home is set on a generous lot offering the best of in-town living. Built in 1940, the property underwent complete renovation & expansion in 2005, followed by significant upgrades by the current owners. At the heart of the home is a showstopping chef's kitchen featuring a La Cornue Chateau 320 stove and oven - a top-of-the-line appliance favored by culinary professionals - along with a generous island, cozy fireplace, and numerous windows overlooking the private, professionally landscaped & fenced-in backyard. The patio with a built-in grill and Alba pizza oven is the perfect place to entertain friends and family. A mudroom with extensive paneled storage keeps daily life effortlessly organized. The main level has an open floorplan that flows seamlessly: a living room with an elegant fireplace & built-in bookshelves, a light filled family room, a paneled office with wet bar and a chic powder room. The dining room blends dining and living spaces to suit modern lifestyles. Upstairs are four spacious bedrooms, three full bathrooms, plus laundry room. The luxurious primary suite features dual walk-in closets, private study and spa-like new bathroom with Porcelanosa tiles, heated floor, walk-in shower and soaking tub. The third floor offers a fifth bedroom, full bath, and a versatile 6th bedroom that can serve as a playroom or bedroo
